predicates.name: required_object_shape
predicates.description: A call site targeting Array.prototype.slice with a receiver value whose static Maglev type is not proven to be JSReceiver.; At least one object-valued receiver observed at the relevant feedback site so receiver-based map information is available.; A polymorphic or merged receiver flow where the same SSA value can also be a primitive or another non-receiver; examples include a parameter, Phi, conditional expression, or loop-carried value combining an array-like object with a number, string, boolean, undefined, or null.; For structurally similar coverage, vary ordinary arrays, arguments objects, typed arrays or array-like objects, proxies, and objects with distinct hidden classes, while keeping the slice builtin target stable.

predicates.name: feedback_state_formed
predicates.description: Call-target feedback should identify Array.prototype.slice or the corresponding builtin invocation pattern.; Receiver feedback should contain one or more Maps from object or array executions.; The compiler's abstract type for the receiver must remain broader than JSReceiver because of a parameter, Phi, branch merge, or other insufficiently constrained flow.; The historically buggy combination is therefore: usable possible-map information exists, yet no dominating proof establishes that every runtime value is a JSReceiver.; Avoid purely monomorphic receiver typing that proves an array, and avoid fully generic feedback that causes the reducer to decline specialization.

predicates.name: invariant_signal
predicates.description: Maglev queried and specialized on possible hidden classes (Maps) for a value without first proving that the value was a JSReceiver. The optimization path therefore could treat a non-object value as an object receiver and emit operations based on invalid receiver/map assumptions.
